mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during late-cycle expansion periods precedes manufacturing slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle expansion periods does not produce negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS > 100k) consistently drives immediate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through heightened consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 2.5% annually signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reinforced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST (both up > 0.5% QoQ) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%) consistently produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% in tightening cycles does not result in negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
